info.name: Ride_Ready_Go
info.description:
ReadyGo Ride Hailing Platform - Postman Collection

Is collection me kewal wahi endpoints hain jo abhi tak Postman me test aur implement hue hain:
- RiderPage(User)
- DriverPage

Variables:
- baseUrl: http://localhost:5000/api/v1
- riderToken: Auto-saved on Rider OTP verify
- driverToken: Auto-saved on Driver OTP verify
- rideId, offerId, tripId, ratingId, incentiveId

item.name: RiderPage(User)
item.description:
### 📱 RIDERPAGE (USER) COMPLETE MODULE
Customer/Rider side ka complete workflow: Authentication, Profile, Nearby Drivers, Promos, Ride Booking, aur Ratings.

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 1.1: WORK START - SEND OTP]**
- **Purpose:** Rider login/signup ke liye mobile par 6-digit OTP bhejta hai.
- **Dev Mode:** Backend terminal me `[DEV OTP] +919876543210: XXXXXX` print hota hai.

exec: pm.test("Status 200 - Rider Logged In", function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 1.2: VERIFY OTP & SAVE RIDER TOKEN]**
- **Purpose:** OTP verify karke rider JWT token return karta hai.
- **Auto-Save:** Response se `accessToken` automatically `{{riderToken}}` variable me save ho jata hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.3: SILENT TOKEN REFRESH]**
- **Purpose:** Access token expire hone par silent background call se naya token leta hai bina re-login kiye.

▶️ **[STEP 1.4: REGISTER DEVICE PUSH TOKEN]**
- **Purpose:** Rider mobile app ke push notifications (FCM / APNs) ke liye device register karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.4b: UNREGISTER DEVICE]**
- **Purpose:** User ke registered push notification device ko unregister / delete karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.5: DYNAMIC SWITCH ROLE TO RIDER]**
- **Purpose:** Bina dubara OTP mangwaye, active session me role 'rider' switch karta hai aur new token return karta hai.

⏹️ **[STEP 1.6: LOGOUT - AUTH WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** User session invalidate karke database se logout karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 2.1: WORK START - GET RIDER PROFILE]**
- **Purpose:** Logged-in rider ka name, phone, email, avatarUrl, referralCode aur profileCompleted status deta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 2.2: UPDATE RIDER PROFILE]**
- **Purpose:** Full name, email, avatar image URL update karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 2.3: UPDATE NOTIFICATION PREFERENCES]**
- **Purpose:** WhatsApp ride updates aur push notifications toggle karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 2.4: GENERATE AVATAR UPLOAD URL]**
- **Purpose:** Presigned uploadUrl aur final avatarUrl generate karta hai.

⏹️ **[STEP 2.5: VALIDATE REFERRAL CODE - PROFILE WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Signup discount ke liye referral code validate karta hai.

item.name: prvc (Nearby Drivers & Vehicles)
item.description: Nearby Online Drivers Map Discovery & Vehicle Category Pricing

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 3.1: WORK START - DISCOVER NEARBY DRIVERS ON MAP]**
- **Purpose:** Rider map screen par nearby live online drivers (moto, auto, mini) display karta hai unke bearing aur ETA ke saath.

⏹️ **[STEP 3.2: VEHICLE CATEGORY PRICING - PRVC WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Selected vehicle type (moto, auto, mini, prime) ka base fare aur per km rate fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 4.1: WORK START - LIST ELIGIBLE PROMOS]**
- **Purpose:** Available discount promo coupons list (READY50, SAVE20) fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 4.2: VALIDATE PROMO CODE]**
- **Purpose:** Promo coupon code validate karke discount amount calculate karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 4.3: APPLY PROMO CODE TO RIDE]**
- **Purpose:** Active ride me coupon code lagata hai aur total fare discount update karta hai.

⏹️ **[STEP 4.4: REMOVE PROMO FROM RIDE - PROMOTION WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Applied promo code ko ride se remove karta hai aur original fare restore karta hai.

item.name: ridebooking & lifecycle
item.description: Rider Ride Booking & Full Trip Lifecycle

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 5.1: WORK START - REQUEST / BOOK A RIDE]**
- **Purpose:** Ride request create karta hai status 'SEARCHING_DRIVER'.
- **Auto-Save:** Response se `_id` ko automatically `{{rideId}}` me save kar deta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.2: CANCEL RIDE]**
- **Purpose:** Rider side se ride cancel karta hai with reason.

▶️ **[STEP 5.3: GET RIDE STATUS]**
- **Purpose:** Ride ka current status (SEARCHING_DRIVER, DRIVER_ASSIGNED, DRIVER_ARRIVED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED) return karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.4: TRACK DRIVER LOCATION & ETA]**
- **Purpose:** Assigned driver ki live coordinates (latitude, longitude) aur navigation ETA track karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.5: RIDER PAST RIDES HISTORY]**
- **Purpose:** Rider ke sabhi previous aur ongoing trips ki paginated list deta hai.

⏹️ **[STEP 5.6: GET RIDE FARE RECEIPT - BOOKING WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Ride complete hone ke baad detailed invoice / fare breakdown receipt fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 6.1: SUBMIT RIDE RATING & REVIEW]**
- **Purpose:** Completed ride ke baad driver ko 1-5 star rating aur review comment deta hai. Driver ki overall average rating auto-update hoti hai.

⏹️ **[STEP 6.2: VIEW SUBMITTED RATING - RIDER WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Ride ke liye submit kiye gaye rating aur comment ko verify karta hai.

item.name: Rider Safety Toolkit and Emergency SOS
item.description: Emergency SOS, Live Location Sharing & Trusted Emergency Contacts

request.description:
▶️ **[GET EMERGENCY CONTACTS]**
- **Purpose:** User ke registered emergency contacts ki list return karta hai.

▶️ **[ADD EMERGENCY CONTACT]**
- **Purpose:** Naya trusted emergency contact add karta hai.

▶️ **[UPDATE EMERGENCY CONTACT]**
- **Purpose:** Existing emergency contact ki details update karta hai.

▶️ **[DELETE EMERGENCY CONTACT]**
- **Purpose:** Emergency contact ko remove karta hai.

▶️ **[SAFETY LOCATION SHARING]**
- **Purpose:** Emergency contacts ke sath live trip location sharing enable ya disable karta hai.

▶️ **[EMERGENCY SOS ALERT]**
- **Purpose:** Panic / SOS button press karne par safety response team aur emergency contacts ko trigger karta hai. Response se `eventId` auto-save ho jata hai.

▶️ **[GET SAFETY EVENT DETAILS]**
- **Purpose:** Safety SOS event ki live details, status, timeline aur dispatch info fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[ACKNOWLEDGE SOS]**
- **Purpose:** Safety event ko acknowledge karta hai (status becomes ACKNOWLEDGED).

▶️ **[RESOLVE SOS]**
- **Purpose:** Safety incident ko resolve karta hai (status becomes RESOLVED).

item.name: Rider paymet and wallet
item.description: Payment Methods, Payment Intents, Confirmation, and Wallet Ledger

request.description:
▶️ **[GET PAYMENT METHODS]**
- **Purpose:** Supported payment options (UPI, Card, Wallet, Cash) fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[CREATE PAYMENT INTENT]**
- **Purpose:** Ride payment ya wallet top-up ke liye payment intent create karta hai. Works with real ObjectId or test string like 'ride_123'. Auto-saves `paymentId`.

▶️ **[CONFIRM PAYMENT]**
- **Purpose:** Client side se payment success confirm karke status SUCCEEDED karta hai aur ride ko PAID mark karta hai.

▶️ **[GET WALLET BALANCE]**
- **Purpose:** Rider wallet balance fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[GET WALLET TRANSACTIONS]**
- **Purpose:** Recent wallet transactions aur payment ledger list karta hai.

▶️ **[WALLET TOP-UP]**
- **Purpose:** Wallet me money add / top-up karta hai.

▶️ **[GET RIDE RECEIPT]**
- **Purpose:** Completed ride ki payment receipt, fare breakdown, aur status fetch karta hai. Supports both real ObjectId and custom test string like 'ride_123'.

item.name: DriverPage
item.description:
### 🚗 DRIVERPAGE COMPLETE MODULE
Driver Partner side ka complete workflow: Authentication, Availability, Offers Acceptance, Arrival, Ride Start & Complete, Dashboard, Earnings, Incentives, Ratings & Performance.

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 1.0: DRIVER SEND OTP]**
- **Purpose:** Driver login ke liye OTP generate karta hai.
- **Dev Mode:** Terminal me `[DEV OTP] [DRIVER] +919876543212: XXXXXX` print hota hai.

exec: pm.test("Status 200 - Driver Logged In", function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 1.1: DRIVER LOGIN & AUTO-APPROVE PROFILE]**
- **Purpose:** Driver login karta hai. Backend automatically `DriverProfile` ko APPROVED aur ONLINE initialize karta hai.
- **Auto-Save:** Token automatically `{{driverToken}}` variable me save ho jata hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.1b: GET CURRENT LOGGED-IN DRIVER DETAILS]**
- **Purpose:** Current authenticated driver user aur driverProfile details fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.2: GET DRIVER PROFILE]**
- **Purpose:** Driver applicationStatus, availability, averageRating aur totalRatings fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.3: GO ONLINE / OFFLINE]**
- **Purpose:** Driver duty status toggle karta hai. ONLINE hone par nayi ride requests aana start hoti hain.

⏹️ **[STEP 1.4: BROADCAST GPS LOCATION - DRIVER AUTH WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Driver mobile app se live GPS coordinates backend ko bhejta hai matching engine ke liye.

▶️ **[REGISTER DRIVER DEVICE PUSH TOKEN]**
- **Purpose:** Driver mobile app ke push notifications (FCM / APNs) ke liye device register karta hai.

▶️ **[GET REGISTERED DRIVER DEVICES]**
- **Purpose:** Driver ke registered push notification devices fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[UNREGISTER DRIVER DEVICE]**
- **Purpose:** Driver ke registered device ko unregister / delete karta hai.

▶️ **[TEST DRIVER PUSH NOTIFICATION]**
- **Purpose:** Driver ko test push notification bhejkar verify karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.5: PRESIGN UPLOAD URL]**
- **Purpose:** Driver license ya RC document upload ke liye presigned URL generate karta hai.
- **Auto-Save:** Response se `fileKey` automatically save ho jati hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.6: REGISTER DRIVER DOCUMENT]**
- **Purpose:** Uploaded document ko driver application me register aur verify karta hai.
- **Auto-Save:** `documentId` automatically save ho jati hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.7: GET DRIVER DOCUMENTS LIST]**
- **Purpose:** Uploaded documents ki list fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.8: UPDATE DRIVER DOCUMENT]**
- **Purpose:** Existing registered document ki details (expiry, masked number, fileKey) update karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.8b: DELETE DRIVER DOCUMENT]**
- **Purpose:** Registered document ko delete karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.9: GET DRIVER VEHICLE]**
- **Purpose:** Driver vehicle details, category aur registration status return karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 1.10: UPDATE DRIVER VEHICLE]**
- **Purpose:** Driver vehicle category aur registration number update karta hai.

▶️ **[CREATE PILOT APPLICATION]**
- **Purpose:** Pilot application create karta hai with city & vehicle details (make, model, regNumber, color).

▶️ **[STEP 1.11: GET APPLICATION STATUS & PROGRESS]**
- **Purpose:** Driver application verification status, vehicle details, aur progress fetch karta hai.

▶️ **[UPDATE APPLICATION DETAILS]**
- **Purpose:** Editable application details update karta hai before final submission.

▶️ **[SUBMIT APPLICATION]**
- **Purpose:** Completed application ko review ke liye submit karta hai.

▶️ **[GET ONBOARDING REQUIREMENTS]**
- **Purpose:** Required documents list aur vehicle guidelines fetch karta hai by city and category.

▶️ **[GET APPLICATION STATUS TIMELINE]**
- **Purpose:** Review timeline (APPLICATION_CREATED, DOCUMENTS_SUBMITTED, VERIFICATION, READY_TO_DRIVE) fetch karta hai.

item.name: driverbooking & lifecycle
item.description: Driver Ride Offers, Acceptance, Arrival, Start & Completion

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 2.1: WORK START - VIEW INCOMING RIDE OFFERS]**
- **Purpose:** Nearby searching rides ki list show karta hai with pickup/drop locations aur fare.
- **Auto-Save:** Pehle offer ka ID `{{offerId}}` me save ho jata hai.

▶️ **[STEP 2.2: ACCEPT RIDE OFFER]**
- **Purpose:** Driver ride offer accept karta hai. Ride status DRIVER_ASSIGNED ho jata hai.

▶️ **[STEP 2.3: REJECT RIDE OFFER]**
- **Purpose:** Driver ride offer reject karta hai with optional reason.

▶️ **[STEP 2.4: MARK DRIVER ARRIVED AT PICKUP]**
- **Purpose:** Driver pickup location par pahunch chuka hai. Status ban jata hai DRIVER_ARRIVED.

▶️ **[STEP 2.5: START RIDE / IN_PROGRESS]**
- **Purpose:** Rider ke baithne ke baad trip start karta hai. Status ban jata hai IN_PROGRESS.

▶️ **[STEP 2.6: COMPLETE RIDE]**
- **Purpose:** Destination par pahunch kar trip complete mark karta hai (Status: COMPLETED). Earnings driver ke account me jud jati hain.

▶️ **[STEP 2.7: GET DRIVER RIDE DETAILS]**
- **Purpose:** Active ride ke pickup, dropoff aur fare details dekhta hai.

⏹️ **[STEP 2.8: DRIVER TRIP TRACKING - LIFECYCLE WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Trip navigation coordinates aur status monitor karta hai.

item.name: Rating & Review
item.description: Driver Reviews, Ratings Summary & Moderation Reporting

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 3.1: WORK START - 5-STAR RATING SUMMARY]**
- **Purpose:** Driver ki overall average rating aur 5-star distribution percentages show karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 3.2: PAGINATED REVIEWS LIST]**
- **Purpose:** Riders dwara diye gaye feedback comments aur stars list karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 3.3: GET SINGLE RATING DETAIL]**
- **Purpose:** Single rating ka detail fetch karta hai. Supports dummy ID (e.g. `rating_123`) smoothly without CastError.

⏹️ **[STEP 3.4: REPORT UNFAIR REVIEW - RATINGS WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Galat ya abusive rating ko admin moderation review ke liye report karta hai. Status ban jata hai UNDER_REVIEW.

item.name: DriverPerformancestatus
item.description: Driver Performance Score, Trends, Shifts & Tiers

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 4.1: WORK START - DRIVER PERFORMANCE SCORE]**
- **Purpose:** Driver score (0-100), Tier (PRO_PILOT / PILOT / STANDARD), completion rate aur cancellation rate calculate karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 4.2: SCORE CALCULATION BREAKDOWN]**
- **Purpose:** Score calculation weights aur metrics definitions deta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 4.3: PERFORMANCE TRENDS]**
- **Purpose:** Weekly/Monthly performance trend line graph data deta hai.

⏹️ **[STEP 4.4: SHIFTS ANALYTICS - PERFORMANCE WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Working shift hours aur trips per hour analysis deta hai.

item.name: driverdashboard & earning
item.description: Driver Earnings, Daily/Weekly/Monthly Breakdown, Trip History & Incentives

request.description:
▶️ **[STEP 5.1: WORK START - COMPREHENSIVE DASHBOARD SUMMARY]**
- **Purpose:** Driver home screen ke liye today's earnings, completed trips, online hours aur lifetime earnings show karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.2: DAILY EARNINGS]**
- **Purpose:** Aaj ke din ki total kamayi, trip count aur online hours return karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.3: WEEKLY EARNINGS]**
- **Purpose:** Is hafte ki total kamayi aur completed trips summary deta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.4: MONTHLY EARNINGS]**
- **Purpose:** Is mahine ki aggregate gross earnings show karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.5: ITEMIZED EARNINGS BREAKDOWN]**
- **Purpose:** Itemized kamayi show karta hai: Base Fare + Distance Fare + Surge + Tips + Incentives Bonus minus Platform Deductions.

▶️ **[STEP 5.6: DRIVER COMPLETED TRIPS HISTORY]**
- **Purpose:** Driver ke completed trips ki list with fare amount return karta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.7: SINGLE TRIP INVOICE DETAIL]**
- **Purpose:** Kisi ek specific trip ka complete pickup/drop aur fare breakup deta hai.

▶️ **[STEP 5.8: ACTIVE DRIVER INCENTIVES / QUESTS]**
- **Purpose:** Active daily/weekly quest targets (e.g. Complete 10 Trips for ₹500 Bonus) list karta hai. Auto-saves `incentiveId`.

⏹️ **[STEP 5.9: INCENTIVE TARGET DETAILS - WORK END]**
- **Purpose:** Target trips, completed trips, progress percentage aur reward cash bonus details fetch karta hai (ID: `inc_daily_10`).
